verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents a widget key fixed to the signal:write scope and a FORELOOP_TOKEN environment variable for CI and agents. Neither shows that a user can issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The widget key is a feedback-submission credential, so it is only an adjacent feature, and nothing says FORELOOP_TOKEN can be limited in scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
